title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Claude Code 2.1.307–2.1.310: MCP reconnect fixes, tool-call safety telemetry, /auto-mode-setup
bullets.summary: Releases 21–23 Oct fix MCP reconnects after sleep/keychain lock, add a telemetry event per stopped or prompted tool call, add /auto-mode-setup that learns from your project, and bring Monitor to Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry.
bullets.how: The Construct: update Mac runners to 2.1.310 — the MCP-reconnect fix directly helps long-lived scheduled sessions; try /auto-mode-setup. PRAGMA: Monitor on Bedrock/Vertex helps enterprise deployments. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: Anthropic launches Claude Duet research preview (proactive daily-brief agent on Opus 5.5)
bullets.summary: Launched 21 Oct for US Claude Pro users on iOS, Android and web; builds a daily brief from connected apps (The Decoder, via aggregator; a newsletter cites 6,000 plugins).
bullets.how: The Construct: benchmark against our Morning/Pulse briefs and note which connectors it prioritizes. PRAGMA: client talking point on proactive personal agents. Brand 9 Signs: maybe, as an owner daily brief.

bullets.title: 1Password for Agents and Walmart agent access: agent sign-in without exposing credentials
bullets.summary: 1Password (22 Oct) lets agents sign into accounts without seeing passwords, with user approval; Walmart will let shoppers connect their own AI agents next month with approval and spending limits.
bullets.how: The Construct: a candidate pattern for credential handling across agents, extends yesterday's agent-identity theme. PRAGMA: governance and agent-identity pitch. Brand 9 Signs: maybe — customers' agents may soon shop signage online, so keep product feeds clean.

bullets.title: Model pricing volatility: Mistral Large 4 price doubled, Inception Mercury 2.5 +400%, DeepSeek V4 Flash output tripled; Kimi K3.1 Pro launches
bullets.summary: Aggregator newsletter (20–24 Oct) reports several API price hikes while Moonshot released Kimi K3.1 Pro (2.8T params, 1M context) on 24 Oct; also notes OpenAI 12-hour prompt caching for Codex.
bullets.how: The Construct: don't hard-wire one provider; route through a gateway with per-model cost tracking and lean on Claude Haiku/caching. PRAGMA: model-cost risk advice for clients. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: AWS guide: Smartsheet MCP server so agents can read/update work-management data
bullets.summary: AWS ML Blog (20 Oct) published a walkthrough for connecting agents to Smartsheet via MCP.
bullets.how: The Construct: reference for a project/scheduling MCP integration pattern. PRAGMA: reusable client-delivery pattern for work-management tools. Brand 9 Signs: maybe, if job tracking ever moves to Smartsheet.

praxis_lesson: Agent trust and cost are now the competitive surfaces (credential vaulting, tool-call telemetry, volatile API pricing), so give each Construct agent an approved, logged credential path and a cost-aware model router instead of binding to one provider.
